# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m tplink_admin.clidoc > docs/commands.md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from `tplinkctl schema`, the clispec v0.2 contract the binary emits
about itself. **Mutating** commands change router state or write local files;
router mutations accept `--plan`/`--dry-run` and need `--yes` (or `confirm=true`
over MCP) to run. Profiles can block any command; see
[`src/tplink_admin/profiles/`](../src/tplink_admin/profiles/).

## Global options

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | string |  |  | router URL (default: http://192.168.0.1) |
| `--username` | string |  |  | local admin username |
| `--password` | string |  |  | local admin password; otherwise prompts or reads TPLINK_PASSWORD |
| `--timeout` | integer |  |  | HTTP timeout in seconds |
| `--client` | string |  | `auto`, `sg` | client type; sg is useful for BE-series routers |
| `--verify-ssl` | boolean |  |  | enable HTTPS certificate verification |
| `--no-verify-ssl` | boolean |  |  | disable HTTPS certificate verification |
| `--json` | boolean |  |  | print JSON to stdout |
| `--plain` | boolean |  |  | print stable TSV/key-value text to stdout |
| `--no-input` | boolean |  |  | never prompt; fail if required input is missing |
| `--no-lock` | boolean |  |  | do not serialize authenticated router sessions |
| `--profile` | string |  | `dangerous`, `device-admin`, `network-admin`, `read-only` | agent policy profile; also reads TPLINK_PROFILE |
| `--reason` | string |  |  | short reason recorded in the audit log for plans and mutations |
| `--enable-commands` | string |  |  | comma-separated allowlist for agent use, e.g. status,leases |
| `--disable-commands` | string |  |  | comma-separated denylist for agent use, e.g. reboot,wifi |

### firmware

```
tplinkctl firmware
```

```

```

### state

save, show, and diff redacted local state snapshots.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl state
```

### state save

save a redacted router state snapshot.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl state save
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | string |  |  | snapshot name; defaults to UTC timestamp |

### state show

show a saved state snapshot.

```
tplinkctl state show
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  | snapshot name; defaults to latest |
| `--list` | boolean |  |  | list saved snapshots |

### state diff

diff two saved state snapshots.

```
tplinkctl state diff
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--before` | string |  |  | older snapshot name; defaults to previous |
| `--after` | string |  |  | newer snapshot name; defaults to latest |
| `--limit` | integer |  | default `100` | maximum changes to print |
| `--raw` | boolean |  |  | disable default filtering of rate/counter/timestamp fields; show every change |
| `--ignore` | string |  |  | additional leaf name or dotted path prefix to skip (repeatable); e.g. --ignore signal_dbm --ignore devices[3] |
| `--only` | string |  |  | restrict the diff to paths starting with this dotted prefix; e.g. wifi |

### wifi

enable or disable a Wi-Fi network.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl wifi <connection> <enabled>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connection` | string | yes | `host_2g`, `host_5g`, `host_6g`, `guest_2g`, `guest_5g`, `guest_6g`, `iot_2g`, `iot_5g`, `iot_6g`, `wired` | for example: host_2g, host_5g, host_6g, guest_2g, iot_2g |
| `enabled` | string | yes |  | on/off |

### wifi-config

configure Wi-Fi channel, channel width, txpower, or SSID.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl wifi-config <connection>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connection` | string | yes | `host_2g`, `host_5g`, `host_6g`, `guest_2g`, `guest_5g`, `guest_6g`, `iot_2g`, `iot_5g`, `iot_6g`, `wired` | for example: host_2g, host_5g, guest_2g, iot_2g |
| `--channel` | string |  |  | channel number (e.g. 1, 6, 11, 36, 48, 149, auto) |
| `--htmode` | string |  |  | channel width / htmode (e.g. 20, 40, 80, 160, auto) |
| `--txpower` | string |  | `low`, `middle`, `high` | transmit power level |
| `--ssid` | string |  |  | Wi-Fi network SSID |
| `--plan` | boolean |  |  | show the planned change without mutating router state |
| `--dry-run` | boolean |  |  | alias for --plan |
| `--yes` | boolean |  |  | confirm Wi-Fi radio configuration change |

### devices

list connected devices with IP, speed, signal, and usage.

```
tplinkctl devices
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--active` | boolean |  |  | show only active devices |
| `--connection` | string |  | `host_2g`, `host_5g`, `host_6g`, `guest_2g`, `guest_5g`, `guest_6g`, `iot_2g`, `iot_5g`, `iot_6g`, `wired` | filter by connection, e.g. host_5g |
| `--name` | string |  |  | filter by hostname substring |
| `--ip` | string |  |  | filter by IP address |
| `--mac` | string |  |  | filter by MAC address |
| `--sort` | string |  | `name`, `ip`, `speed`, `usage`, `signal`; default `name` |  |
| `--top` | integer |  |  | limit rows after filtering and sorting |

Show one device by hostname, IP, or MAC.

### device access

Show or change access-control enforcement.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl device access <access_state>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `access_state` | string | yes | `status`, `on`, `off` | status, on, or off |
| `--mode` | string |  | `black`, `white` | set blacklist or whitelist mode when turning access control on/off |
| `--plan` | boolean |  |  | show the planned change without mutating router state |
| `--dry-run` | boolean |  |  | alias for --plan |
| `--yes` | boolean |  |  | confirm access-control change |

### device reserve

Reserve a device's DHCP address.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl device reserve <query>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | device hostname substring, IP address, or MAC address |
| `--ip` | string |  |  | reserved IP address; defaults to the device's current IP |
| `--name` | string |  |  | reservation hostname; defaults to the current device name |
| `--plan` | boolean |  |  | show the planned change without mutating router state |
| `--dry-run` | boolean |  |  | alias for --plan |
| `--yes` | boolean |  |  | confirm reservation creation |

| `--dry-run` | boolean |  |  | alias for --plan |

### device vpn

Include or exclude a device from VPN client routing.

**Mutating.** VPN device-list reads work on firmware 1.3.5; routing mutations have not been live revalidated.

```
tplinkctl device vpn <query> <enabled>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | device hostname substring, IP address, or MAC address |
| `enabled` | string | yes |  | on/off |
| `--plan` | boolean |  |  | show the planned change without mutating router state |
| `--dry-run` | boolean |  |  | alias for --plan |
| `--yes` | boolean |  |  | confirm VPN client device change |

### watch

sample read-only router state repeatedly.

```
tplinkctl watch <watch_target>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `watch_target` | string | yes | `status`, `devices`, `speed`, `health` | state to sample |
| `--interval` | string |  | default `5.0` | seconds between samples |
| `--count` | integer |  | default `3` | number of samples |
| `--stream` | boolean |  |  | print JSON Lines as samples arrive |
| `--active` | boolean |  |  | show only active devices |
| `--connection` | string |  | `host_2g`, `host_5g`, `host_6g`, `guest_2g`, `guest_5g`, `guest_6g`, `iot_2g`, `iot_5g`, `iot_6g`, `wired` | filter by connection, e.g. host_5g |
| `--name` | string |  |  | filter by hostname substring |
| `--ip` | string |  |  | filter by IP address |
| `--mac` | string |  |  | filter by MAC address |
| `--sort` | string |  | `name`, `ip`, `speed`, `usage`, `signal`; default `name` |  |
| `--top` | integer |  |  | limit rows after filtering and sorting |

### raw

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl raw <path>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | router API path, for example /admin/network?form=wan_ipv4 |
| `--data` | string |  |  | request payload string |
| `--data-file` | string |  |  | read request payload from a file |
| `--ignore-response` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `--ignore-errors` | boolean |  |  |  |

| `--name` | string |  |  | filter route name |

### config

manage saved CLI defaults.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl config
```

### config path

print config file path.

```
tplinkctl config path
```

### config show

show effective config.

```
tplinkctl config show
```

### config set

save non-secret defaults.

**Mutating.**

```
tplinkctl config set
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Values / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | string |  |  |  |
| `--username` | string |  |  |  |
| `--client` | string |  | `auto`, `sg` |  |
| `--timeout` | integer |  |  |  |
| `--verify-ssl` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `--no-verify-ssl` | boolean |  |  |  |

## Exit codes

| Code | Kind | Retryable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1` | `router` | yes | Router returned an error or unreadable response. |
| `1` | `conflict` |  | Ambiguous query or router state did not match the requested change. |
| `1` | `internal` |  | Unexpected local CLI failure. |
| `2` | `usage` |  | Invalid arguments, unknown profile, or missing required flags. |
| `3` | `not_found` |  | Requested device, snapshot, or resource was not found. |
| `4` | `permission` |  | Command blocked by profile, allowlist, or denylist. |
| `5` | `confirmation_required` |  | Mutation refused because --yes was not provided. |
| `6` | `auth` |  | Router password missing or authentication failed. |
